judge.quote: "Set `MBEDTLS_CONFIG_FILE` to point at a full replacement config ... Set `MBEDTLS_USER_CONFIG_FILE` / `MBEDTLS_PSA_CRYPTO_USER_CONFIG_FILE` to a small overlay file that overrides individual options on top of the base config"
judge.why: The answer explicitly distinguishes the full-replacement config file macro from the overlay macro that overrides individual options on top of the base.

marks.text: **names what catches a contradictory configuration, and says it fails the COMPILE** rather than being detected at run time — `include/mbedtls/check_config.h` (202 `#error` directives) or `library/check_crypto_config.h` (17), which raise a PREPROCESSOR error so the translation unit does not compile. Both halves are required: naming the header without the compile-time consequence, or asserting a compile failure without naming what raises it, does not earn the mark

judge.quote: "`include/mbedtls/check_config.h` is included last, after finalization, and is nothing but a long chain of `#if defined(...) && !(...)` / `#error \"...\"` blocks — a compile-time assertion pass with no runtime cost" ... "fails the build with a named `#error` the moment two options conflict"
judge.why: Names check_config.h and explicitly states it fails the build/compile via #error rather than at runtime.
